verdict.rationale: Ubuntu states that Ubuntu Desktop is certified on the Raspberry Pi and delivers a rich developer experience on that low-cost Arm board (ubuntu-docs-5). Its general claims of being a primary platform for major IDEs and toolchains (ubuntu-docs-1, ubuntu-docs-17) back the 'full developer experience' part. missing for 10: Raspberry Pi installation or setup documentation, evidence of other single-board computers beyond the Pi, performance or hardware-requirement details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
